maddeler.e:
أستوء (form X)
# أَسْتَوْءِ (ʔastawʔi) /ʔas.taw.ʔi/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَوْأَى (istawʔā) and اِسْتَوْءَى (istawʔā)
# أُسْتَوْءَ (ʔustawʔa) /ʔus.taw.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَوْأَى (istawʔā) and اِسْتَوْءَى (istawʔā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
